FINAL NOTICE

To: Exampla UK Limited
Firm Reference Number: 999001
Address: 1 Example Street, London EC1A 1AA
Date: 12 March 2025

1. ACTION
1.1. For the reasons given in this Final Notice, the Authority hereby imposes on Exampla UK Limited ("Exampla UK") a financial penalty of £1,400,000 pursuant to section 206 of the Act.
1.2. Exampla UK agreed to resolve this matter and qualified for a 30% (stage 1) discount under the Authority's executive settlement procedures. Were it not for this discount, the Authority would have imposed a financial penalty of £2,000,000 on Exampla UK.

2. SUMMARY OF REASONS
2.1. Between 1 January 2022 and 31 December 2023 Exampla UK breached Principle 3 of the Authority's Principles for Businesses and SYSC 6.1.1R by failing to maintain adequate anti-money laundering systems and controls.
2.2. Mr Alex Placeholder, the firm's money laundering reporting officer at the time, raised concerns in 2022 which were not acted on.

3. DEFINITIONS
3.1. "the Act" means the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.
